## The review problem
Who reviews what, and what must they decide? Keep the situation entirely fictional.

## Claim and references
A claim, references that support or challenge it, and missing information.

## Expected human review
Which question must remain open? What would the reviewer need next?

## Proposed control and acceptance check
What should a tool report? What must it avoid concluding? Describe an observable pass/fail condition without assuming the capability exists.

## Sharing check
- [ ] This scenario is invented, is not a disguised identifiable case, and contains no third-party confidential material.
